Gets the enrollment certificate details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/enrollmentCert/:enrollmentCertId

Gets the enrollment certificate details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

enrollmentCertId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the signing cert.

Responses

400

Example (auto)
SCHEMA
allowSigning
boolean

Not applicable for put and post calls. This field will be extracted from certificate.

string
REQUIRED

certificate text in pem format.

string

Read only property. Applicable only for GET calls, ignored in PUT/POST calls.

Possible values: [ZAPP_CLIENT, ISOLATION_CLIENT, NONE, APP_PROTECTION]

int32
